title: Hunter’s Bounty System
description: A bounty system where you can place bounties on players using items through a simple GUI. If you kill the target, you claim their bounty rewards, making PvP more risky and rewarding. You can use /bounty to open the menu and interact with it!
body:
# Bounty System (Including Diamonds)
A new bounty system has been added that lets players place bounties on others using items through an in-game GUI. When a targeted player is killed by another player, the killer receives the bounty reward, creating higher-risk PvP and more rewarding combat encounters.

(Everyone starts with a base bounty of 10 diamonds, which increases by 10 diamonds each time you successfully claim a bounty.)

The system includes a simple interface accessed with /bounty, along with full command support to manage everything: /bounty place <player> to set a bounty, /bounty cancel <player> to remove one, /bounty list to view active bounties, and /bounty leaderboard to see the top bounty hunters.
